PROJECT(SHELL)

spec2def(rshell.dll rshell.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# rshell.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/rshell-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# exactly as it already does for ShellDDEInit since dde.cpp flipped.
# CMenuBand is Rust-owned (menuband-rust, built in dll/win32/shell32/shellmenu). rshell
# links the shared libmenuband_rust.a and provides its own MenuBandRustModuleLock/Unlock
# (misc.cpp) over rshell's COM module.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(rshell_shims OBJECT CQuickLaunchBand.cpp misc.cpp)
target_link_libraries(rshell_shims PRIVATE shellbars uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libbrowseui libuxtheme libshlwapi libadvapi32 libshell32 libcomctl32 libgdi32 libole32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(rshell_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(rshell_shims PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-Wno-overloaded-virtual>")
endif()
add_cargo_module(rshell rshell-cargo rshell.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos
    EXTRA_DEPENDS rshell_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk shellbars)
add_custom_command(TARGET rshell POST_BUILD
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy
     "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rshell.dll"
     "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/base/shell/explorer/rshell.dll"
  COMMENT "Copying to output directory")
add_custom_command(TARGET rshell POST_BUILD
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy
     "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rshell.dll"
     "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/base/shell/filebrowser/rshell.dll"
  COMMENT "Copying to output directory")
